en: The image shows a richly decorated, classical religious mural divided into three arched sections. The central figures are haloed, dressed in biblical robes, and the scenes include the resurrected Christ with followers, a man peering into a tomb, and Christ speaking to a kneeling disciple with sheep in the background. The art is surrounded by ornate, gold-accented architectural designs, with Latin text along the bottom.
